host_load_before.scope: Host load is observed, not controlled; other jobs may affect tail latency.

reproduction.pairing_rule: Same interpreter, script, environment and load arguments; change source-root/output/label only; after also supplies compare.
reproduction.environment_policy: Child inherits only PATH, locale and TZ; no HOME, PYTHONPATH, OAI/Hermes credentials or configuration variables.

limitations.experiment: Isolated loopback + real Core/bridge routing + synthetic host; not production performance.
limitations.authentication: Synthetic local principal; random in-memory bridge token, never persisted.
limitations.persistence: Synthetic host facts stay in memory. Core operation ledger is selected as memory or an isolated on-disk SQLite file; no native host process-restart claim.
limitations.percentiles: Empirical nearest rank; P99 null below 1000 observations; no sample size establishes production P99 here.
limitations.denominator: Every attempted request stays in success/failure denominator; fault injection is separate from semantic success.
limitations.timeout: Failures retain observed submit_to_finished; unobserved final latency is null, never zero or a successful latency.
limitations.resources: Core, bridges, synthetic hosts and load client share worker process; resource usage is combined.
limitations.clock: One process monotonic clock only; wall time is provenance, not cross-machine latency.

unsupported_metrics.android_click_ms: No Android device or input instrumentation.
unsupported_metrics.android_request_start_ms: Loopback submission is not Android T1.
unsupported_metrics.android_sse_read_ms: Loopback SSE read is not Android T6.
unsupported_metrics.android_render_ms: No Android device or frame/render instrumentation.
unsupported_metrics.cross_machine_network_ms: Only loopback in one process; no synchronized cross-machine tracing.
unsupported_metrics.db_queue_wait_ms: No comparable database admission/queue boundary in both sources; ledger mode is recorded separately.
unsupported_metrics.agent_started_ms: Synthetic handler entry is not real Agent execution.
unsupported_metrics.agent_compute_ms: Injected synthetic delay is not model compute time.
